_intro_male_1.text: Welcome to Smart Dictation — a zero-cost ($0), open-source web system started on October 22 (2 weeks ago) by Hansana and powered by autonomous AI agents on his own system.

_intro_male_2.text: Built to test critical thinking and problem-solving skills with a positive mindset for our society in Sri Lanka for free — never for money or profit — mastering open-source databases within two months without A/L IT to create my Remote Desktop PC (RDP) project, lab environment, and upcoming flagship IT project for Sri Lanka's IT field.

_intro_male_3.text: With strict privacy protection at its core, no personal data is ever shared, no unnecessary data is collected, and every session review, feedback chat, and diagnostic report is one hundred percent end-to-end encrypted (AES-GCM) so your privacy is completely safe.

_intro_male_4.text: Engineered to run smoothly even on low mobile data with live Lecturer Mode updates — Tap Start Dictation on the right for the step-by-step guide and begin from Word #1!

_guide_2.text: Listen twice, then write in five seconds.

_guide_3.text: Check all thirty words in order.
